source: Real transactions for the types that belong to a whole tx, not to one output. Each raw tx was read from WhatsOnChain (GET /v1/bsv/main/tx/<txid>/hex) and hashes to its txid. A type lists the vectors it is tested against under tx_vectors; expected says whether the classifier gives the tx that type.

vectors.name: tx_nlocktime_enforced
vectors.description: Lock time 399,988 (a height) with its one input's sequence at 0xfffffffe, so the lock binds: Bitcoin Core's guard against fee sniping

vectors.name: tx_nlocktime_ignored
vectors.description: Lock time 973,899 (a height) with every input's sequence final at 0xffffffff, so the rules ignore it
